name: angina-good
description: Well-handled call (adapted from the voice findings): asks how he is feeling, draws out the chest tightness, timing and spray, advises 999 calmly.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Oh hello, is that the surgery? I'm ringing about my prescription.

transcript.speaker: trainee
transcript.text: Good morning, Pen-y-Bryn Surgery, Sam speaking. Who am I speaking to?

transcript.speaker: trainee
transcript.text: Thank you Mr Pritchard. Is the prescription for you?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, it's my spray for my angina. I've used quite a lot of it, I need another one.

transcript.speaker: trainee
transcript.text: I'll come to that. You said you've used quite a lot. How are you feeling right now?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Well... I've got a bit of a tight feeling in my chest, to be honest. I'm just sitting here.

transcript.speaker: trainee
transcript.text: How long have you had that tightness?

transcript.speaker: trainee
transcript.text: And has the spray helped it?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, not really. I don't like to make a fuss.

transcript.speaker: trainee
transcript.text: You're not making a fuss, Mr Pritchard, you did the right thing to ring. Chest tightness at rest that the spray hasn't eased needs an ambulance. I want you to put the phone down and call 999 now, and I'm letting the duty doctor know.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Oh dear. All right, I will.

transcript.speaker: trainee
transcript.text: Tell them exactly what you told me, and if anything changes before they arrive, tell them straight away. Please call now.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes. Thank you for your help.

expect.flagsReason: Advised 999 straight away after drawing out the red flag.

greeting.reason: Own name, practice, caller name and for whom.

information.reason: Unlocked chest tightness, onset time and the spray not helping.

role.reason: No diagnosis. Saying chest tightness needs an ambulance is the key's outcome, not a diagnosis.

explanation.reason: Said 999, why, and tell them if anything changes; 2 is likely, though a "what if worse" item is odd when 999 is already the top escalation.

manner.reason: Calm, reassuring with a man who plays things down.
